title.en: Appointment of Collector of Land Revenue

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
State Lands Act
(Chapter 314)
Appointment of Collector of Land Revenue
N 1
G.N. No. S 477/1946
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
The following persons have been appointed to be Collectors of Land Revenue:
(a) the officer performing the duties of the Commissioner of Lands to be the Collector of Land Revenue; and
[477/46]
[1.4.46]
(b) the Chief Surveyor to be a Collector of Land Revenue.
[2494/73]
[17.8.73]
